title: Devour mandible
concept: Devour (maw mutation): the spider's fangs become a pair of big serrated mandibles that seize and eat people.
sheet: Studio product photograph of a single short thick curved sickle blade on its own, carved from dark chitin: a thick bulbous dark brown socket at one end, a heavy blade curving to a hooked black point, a few jagged teeth along the inner edge, matte satin dark chocolate-brown, short stiff bristles round the socket, side view, no insect, no body. A single object alone, whole object in frame with generous space around it, plain light grey seamless background, soft even studio light, no floor, no shadows, no text or logos.
notes: Budget: 1,000 triangles, 512 maps. Rigid, on the maw mount; one mesh used for both sides (mirrored).
sheet_v1: Top-down photograph looking straight down at a single giant curved mandible lying on its own, like a stag beetle's jaw removed and cleaned: a thick rounded base tapering into a long hooked point that curves inward, a row of jagged teeth along the inner edge, matte satin dark chocolate-brown chitin fading to a glossy black tip, a few short stiff bristles at the base, no insect, no head, no legs. A single object alone, whole object in frame with generous space around it, plain light grey seamless background, soft even studio light, no floor, no shadows, no text or logos.
